observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon DSLR camera with an AF-P DX NIKKOR 18-55mm lens.
The camera body is black with gold lettering on the top plate.
The model 'D3400' is clearly printed on the top right of the body in photo 1.
The lens barrel shows 'NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G VR' and 'AF-P DX NIKKOR' in photo 0.
Photo 2 shows the rear label with 'NIKON DIGITAL CAMERA D3400 N1517' and 'MADE IN THAILAND'.
The lens barrel has some white residue or dust, and the lens cap is missing in photo 2.

claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show the Nikon logo and D3400 model number on the camera body.
photo 0 and photo 2 show the lens specification.
The photos show the camera and lens in good cosmetic condition, but the actual usage history is unknown.
There is no photo of the camera powered on or taking a photo to confirm the sensor and shutter are functional.

risks.proof: A photo of the lens glass with the lens cap on.

risks.risk: The camera may have a dead sensor or a faulty shutter.
risks.proof: A photo of the camera powered on with a clear image of the sensor or a video of it taking a photo.

risks.risk: The lens may be a generic or third-party lens rather than the original Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR 18-55mm.
risks.proof: A photo of the lens barrel with the manufacturer's name and serial number.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the lens glass with the lens cap on to check for fungus or scratches.
Photo of the camera powered on with a clear image of the sensor.
Photo of the lens barrel showing the manufacturer's name and serial number.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
